actual_scope: For the frozen frame-506 matcher of helper 462, prove that each of the forward and return carries has at most 48 nonzero corrections under the PR #4957 formula, that both bounds are attained for every odd integer q>=5, and that the published pair envelope 128 is not sharp.
scope_change_reason: Discussion #1166 comment 19137812 asks for one literal route ledger on the PR #4957 A0 to A1 edge. This package prices only the carry corrections of that fixed frame-506 invocation. It does not claim supplier admission.
bottleneck_link: BIT is the next cap after the selected complex supplier. A sharp carry count is one charged line of the ordinary route ledger. The predecessor already treats a finite carry constant as lower order, so this correction does not by itself move kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the frame-506 carry identities, the q=3 census and the unit-column control. Do not implement the native compiler or retune an exponent.
evidence: PROOF.md closed forms for every integer q>=5, recomputed from the source columns and the source carry formula; exhaustive 6561-row census at q=3; unit-column and cleared-denominator controls.

open_questions.question: Does the elimination-word return for S^{-1} have fewer than 48 nonzero intermediate carries on one high row?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 48-return half of this ledger is the closed-form correction (u S^{-1}-h)/q, not the 5-scale 14-shear word.
open_questions.first_step: Attach a carry digit to each elementary factor of S^{-1} on one high row of r(q).
open_questions.blocked_by: PR #4957 does not fix which implementation is the physical return.

open_questions.question: Can the 32-correction gap move an ordinary exponent once it is placed in the charged bill?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A lower-order constant does not change the selected frontier, but a bill that stops absorbing it would.
open_questions.first_step: Substitute 112 for 128 in the PR #4957 three-level gap arithmetic and see whether any recorded gap changes sign.
open_questions.blocked_by: The predecessor states that finite carry constants are lower order once its gaps are positive.
